title: Экзамен-чекпоинт C1 (формат Cambridge)
intro:
Мини-тест в формате, близком к Reading & Use of English части настоящего Cambridge C1 Advanced (CAE). Если цель — реальный экзамен C1 Advanced или IELTS 7+, этот тест честно покажет, готова ли грамматическая база.

💡 Как проходить. Таймер на 25 минут, без словаря и подсказок. На реальном C1 Advanced эта часть занимает около 90 минут и идет вместе с чтением — здесь только грамматическая часть для быстрой самопроверки.

sections.title: Часть 1. Multiple-choice cloze
sections.html:
Despite the (1) ____ evidence in favour of remote work, many executives remain (2) ____ about its long-term impact on company culture. Critics argue that spontaneous collaboration (3) ____ when teams are physically dispersed, while advocates (4) ____ that flexibility improves both morale and output. The (5) ____ likely outcome is a hybrid model that (6) ____ elements of both approaches.

  1. (a) mount (b) mounting (c) mounted (d) mounts
  2. (a) sceptical (b) suspicious (c) doubtful (d) uncertain — (какое слово чаще всего сочетается с «remain ___ about»?)
  3. (a) suffers (b) harms (c) damages (d) hurts
  4. (a) maintain (b) assure (c) persuade (d) convince
  5. (a) most (b) more (c) much (d) many
  6. (a) combines (b) consists (c) mixes up (d) adds up
Ответы к части 1
  1. (b) mounting (mounting evidence — устойчивая коллокация)
  2. (a) sceptical (remain sceptical about — классическая пара)
  3. (a) suffers (harm/damage требуют дополнения; collaboration suffers — «страдает»)
  4. (a) maintain (maintain that — «утверждать»; assure/persuade/convince требуют объекта: assure someone that)
  5. (a) most
  6. (a) combines

sections.title: Часть 2. Open cloze
sections.html:
It is widely acknowledged (1) ____ language proficiency alone does not guarantee effective communication. (2) ____ much depends on register, tone and cultural nuance as (3) ____ grammar. Not (4) ____ must a speaker be grammatically accurate, but they must (5) ____ be sensitive to context. (6) ____ this reason, advanced learners often benefit more from exposure than from further rule-based study.

Ответы к части 2
  1. that
  2. As (As much depends on X as on Y — парная конструкция)
  3. on
  4. only (Not only must a speaker be… — инверсия)
  5. also
  6. For (For this reason…)

sections.title: Часть 3. Word formation
sections.html:
1. The report drew attention to the ____ (GLOBE) nature of the crisis.
  2. Her argument, though controversial, was undeniably ____ (PERSUADE).
  3. The committee's ____ (RELUCTANT) to act drew widespread criticism.
  4. Such a ____ (SIMPLE) view of the issue overlooks its real complexity.
  5. The negotiations required considerable ____ (DIPLOMAT) skill.
  6. His remarks were widely seen as an ____ (JUSTIFY) attack on the policy.
Ответы к части 3
  1. global
  2. persuasive
  3. reluctance
  4. simplistic
  5. diplomatic
  6. unjustified / unjustifiable

sections.title: Часть 4. Key word transformation
sections.html:
1. It is thought that the company will announce layoffs soon. (EXPECTED) → “The company ___ layoffs soon.”
  2. He only understood the risk after he had signed the contract. (UNTIL) → “Not ___ the contract did he understand the risk.”
  3. I regret not having taken that job offer. (WISH) → “I ___ that job offer.”
  4. It's possible that the delay was caused by the storm. (HAVE) → “The delay ___ by the storm.”
  5. Nobody could have predicted such a dramatic outcome. (ANYONE) → “At no point ___ such a dramatic outcome.”
Ответы к части 4
  1. is expected to announce
  2. until he had signed
  3. wish I had taken
  4. may/might have been caused
  5. could anyone have predicted

sections.title: 📊 Как читать результат
sections.html:
Всего 23 вопроса.

  • 20-23 верных — уверенный C1, можно пробовать себя на реальном CAE practice test.
  • 15-19 верных — C1 в процессе, вернись к темам, где ошибся (особенно если ошибки в части 4).
  • меньше 15 — еще есть незакрытые темы в C1, вернись к контрольному чек-листу в конце хаба.
💡 Это не официальный тест и не гарантия реального балла на экзамене — только ориентир. Для реальной подготовки к C1 Advanced смотри официальные примеры на cambridgeenglish.org.
